hours.description: Hours per filter to give, capped by the project's goal. 0 takes the goal.

exposure.description: Sub length for a filter with no entry in `exposures`. 0 takes the middle of the project's range.

exposures.description: The rig's own sub length per filter, seconds.

night.description: The night the rig is in, so the first deal is tonight's.

moon.description: How much of the Moon is lit tonight, 0–1.

moonUp.description: The fraction of the dark hours the Moon is up, 0–1.
